text: 64 teams in a knockout cup: five rounds and a final. Rounds 1 and 2: two pots, one with the Bundesliga and 2. text: Final table in 2026-27, as the FIGC's Federal Council decided on 26 May 2026 on the proposal of the Lega Calcio Serie A, departing for this season from art. 51 of the NOIF. If two teams finish level on points in first place, the title (Campione d'Italia) goes to the winner of a single play-off match at the home of the team better placed in the mini-table (classifica avulsa); if it is level after normal time, there is no extra time and penalties decide. Where more than two teams are level, and for all the other places in the table, the classifica avulsa decides in this order: a) points in the matches between the teams concerned, b) goal difference in those matches, c) goal difference over the whole championship, d) goals scored over the whole championship, e) drawing of lots. If a team that would play the play-off is a finalist in a UEFA competition, the classifica avulsa decides instead. The number of clubs, matches per club and points per win are not stated on any page of the organiser or the federation that could be read (see the Wikipedia row).

If more than two teams are level, the classifica avulsa picks the two; if one of them is a finalist in a UEFA competition, the classifica avulsa decides instead. The Regionalliga Nordost champion goes up directly this season (the direct place rotates between Nord, Nordost and Bayern), and the West and Südwest champions every season. The matches are DFB matches under DFB rules; the DFB supervises and organises the round.
basis: published: BFV Auf- und Abstiegsregelung der Regionalliga Bayern for 2026/2027 and the NOFV's Regionalliga Nordost page naming 2026/27 (two organisers, each for the season), with the BFV's league page (2026/27) and the NFV's league page (no season) for the rotation and the DFB's role. Read in runs 2 and 3 of PR #234.

text: 2026-27: late May to early June 2027. The matches follow the Regionalliga Bayern's last matchday, which its framework calendar puts in late May 2027; in 2026 the first leg was at the end of May and the return at the start of June. Month level only; the days will be on the organiser's pages.
basis: Inferred from the BFV framework calendar 2026/2027 for the Regionalliga Bayern (Stand June 2026, read in run 3 of PR #234) and the 2026 dates in Wikipedia (de) Fußball-Regionalliga 2025/26 (run 4; observed past cycle, one third-party source).

text: The DFB supervises and organises the round, so it fixes the days and kick-offs; its sites are closed to this research. In 2026 the matches came at the end of May and the start of June, after the Regionalliga seasons ended. Expect the same pattern in 2027 and check the dates by hand.
basis: Inferred (CLAUDE.md rule 9: schedule rows are month level and inferred only; observed past cycle): the DFB's role from the NFV's league page (run 3 of PR #234) and the 2026 dates from Wikipedia (de) Fußball-Regionalliga 2025/26 (run 4). One cycle.

text: The DFB, which runs the round, has its sites closed to this research, so follow the two leagues whose champions meet in 2027. Bayern (BFV): the Regionalliga Bayern page and its results page (which showed the 2025-26 season when read), the BFV app (results, news, push messages for favourite leagues and teams), the monthly BFV fan newsletter, and the BFV's TV and video page (BFV.TV, Sporttotal.tv livestreams); the BFV's league page links a WhatsApp channel and a YouTube channel (listed, not opened). Nord (NFV): the Regionalliga Nord page, its results service (it loads fussball.de only after a consent click, not made), the newsletter sign-up, and the links NordFV Live (nordfv.tv), Facebook, Instagram and YouTube (listed, not opened). No page read names a broadcaster for the 2027 matches.
basis: The organisers of the two feeding leagues, not of the round; their pages show no season except the BFV's league page (2026/27) and results page (2025/26). Read in runs 3 and 4 of PR #234.

text: Holder: in 2026 Würzburger Kickers, from the Regionalliga Bayern, beat 1. FC Lokomotive Leipzig, champion of the Regionalliga Nordost, and play in the 3. Liga in 2026-27; the Bavarian champion, 1. FC Nürnberg II, had waived its place in the matches. The best-placed team entitled to promotion takes part; had a team waived or a league had none, the other side would have had a bye.
